title: SCHC timer guards allow post-construction clock substitution
description: python/src/lichen/schc/fragment.py:SchcSessionManager and python/src/lichen/schc/reassembly.py:_AuthenticatedReassemblyManager wrap lambda: self._clock() in _ValidatedSchcClock, so the guarded callback identity stays constant while the actual self._clock field remains freely replaceable. Replacing _clock with a non-regressing attacker-controlled callable is undetected: a large jump can prematurely expire active sessions/hold-downs and retire wire capabilities; a frozen value can retain them indefinitely. This undercuts the fail-stop clock design and differs from LinkLayer's immutable MonotonicClock binding. Bind an exact immutable clock capability/callback snapshot directly (and ideally share the LinkLayer clock), fail closed on reference/domain mutation, and add forward-jump/freeze/substitution tests for both managers.
